citations.title: About PolyAI: Leadership, Mission, and Company Story
excerpts: PolyAI helps enterprises become the best version of themselves in every customer interaction. We work with them to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents that handle their most complex customer conversations. PolyAI started with a simple observation: enterprises shouldn't have to choose between scale and quality in customer service. Our founders, Cambridge machine learning researchers, believed voice AI could handle real complex dialog, not just simple requests. Today, we power billions of customer conversations for the world's leading brands. Our Agentic Dialog Platform combines purpose-built AI with enterprise-grade controls, letting companies deploy agents that sound and act like their human representatives.

basis.reasoning: The official description identifies enterprises as the audience and explains that PolyAI builds, runs, governs and improves dialog agents for complex customer conversations. Source: https://poly.ai/about
